dedupe_keys.name: lebensmittelwarnung de official german food and consumer product warnings and recalls from the federal states and bvl

description: This portal is Germany's official channel for public warnings about unsafe food and other consumer products, the national record of food recalls and withdrawals. Warnings are published by the food safety authorities of the sixteen federal states and by the Federal Office of Consumer Protection and Food Safety (BVL) under the German food and feed code. Coverage is Germany, with current and past warnings searchable by product type (from meat and dairy to baby food, cosmetics and tattoo inks), by reason (allergens, foreign bodies, harmful substances, pathogens, residues and contaminants, misleading labelling) and by the states where the product was sold. Each warning page describes the product concerned and the reason for the warning. Warnings are free and available through the searchable website and through RSS feeds for the whole country or each state; there is no bulk download or open licence stated. Caveats: records must be collected from the feed or pages, product categories are broad, and warnings cover public alerts, not all trade withdrawals. Simulation uses: building event histories of food contamination incidents for food supply chain disruption and recall models, and monitoring live alerts. Related records: the UK FSA food alerts API (data-fsa-food-alerts-api), openFDA food enforcement (data-openfda-food-enforcement) and the French RappelConso data (data-rappelconso-product-recalls) are equivalent recall records in other countries.
